cause: The source-bound torso_waist constant inverse-bind leaf has Y=-pi/2 and X=-0.89605538. SourceBossMotion.blend always converts its quaternion back to Euler angles, even when endpoints are identical. The former independent X/Z atan2 formulas each become atan2(near-zero,near-zero) at this singularity, losing the coupled twist. Static Python matrix checks did not perform that runtime quaternion/Euler round trip.
fix: Keep the original shortest-path quaternion slerp. Extract Euler angles from a double-normalized quaternion matrix. atan2(-r20,hypot(r00,r10)) gives Y; when cos(Y)<1e-6 preserve the coupled X/Z twist in X and choose Z=0. Linear position and scale interpolation remain unchanged.
